source: Public-domain melodies for the Atlas's First steps and Ready to read tiers (the coach's own, before ABRSM Initial), written out for piano (tinyNotation: c = middle C, c' = the C above, C = the C below; # sharp). Each is the traditional melody note for note; a version in another five-finger position is the same tune moved (labelled so), and a left hand marked 'held notes' is the coach's own simple accompaniment, not part of the tune. Fingers are worked out from the hand position ('C', 'G', 'black').

tunes.title: Hot Cross Buns (black keys)
tunes.right: a#4 g# f#2 a#4 g# f#2 f#8 f# f# f# g# g# g# g# a#4 g# f#2
tunes.text: Your first tune is all on the three black keys: fingers 2, 3 and 4 stay on them the whole time. Start on the highest of the three.

tunes.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb (black keys)
tunes.right: a#4 g# f# g# a# a# a#2 g#4 g# g#2 a#4 c'# c'#2 a#4 g# f# g# a# a# a# a# g# g# a# g# f#1
tunes.text: Fingers 2, 3 and 4 on the three black keys again. Twice, your pinky hops up to the next black key for 'little lamb'.

tunes.title: Hot Cross Buns
tunes.right: e4 d c2 e4 d c2 c8 c c c d d d d e4 d c2
tunes.text: Thumb on middle C, then fingers 2 and 3 on D and E. Sing the words while you play: hot cross buns, hot cross buns, one a penny, two a penny, hot cross buns.

tunes.title: Hot Cross Buns (left hand)
tunes.left: E4 D C2 E4 D C2 C8 C C C D D D D E4 D C2
tunes.text: The same tune, low down with the left hand: pinky on C, fingers 4 and 3 on D and E.

tunes.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
tunes.right: e4 d c d e e e2 d4 d d2 e4 g g2 e4 d c d e e e e d d e d c1
tunes.text: Right hand on C, thumb on middle C. Most of the tune uses fingers 1, 2 and 3; finger 5 plays G for 'little lamb'.

tunes.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb (left hand)
tunes.left: E4 D C D E E E2 D4 D D2 E4 G G2 E4 D C D E E E E D D E D C1
tunes.text: Mary with the left hand, pinky on C. Your thumb plays G for 'little lamb'.

tunes.title: Au clair de la lune
tunes.right: c4 c c d e2 d2 c4 e d d c1 c4 c c d e2 d2 c4 e d d c1
tunes.text: A French song about the moonlight. It starts with three Cs in a row, and the same line comes twice.

tunes.title: Au clair de la lune (left hand)
tunes.left: C4 C C D E2 D2 C4 E D D C1 C4 C C D E2 D2 C4 E D D C1
tunes.text: The moonlight song with the left hand: pinky on C for the three Cs.

tunes.title: Ode to Joy
tunes.right: e4 e f g g f e d c c d e e4. d8 d2 e4 e f g g f e d c c d e d4. c8 c2
tunes.text: A famous tune by Beethoven. It walks up and down by steps, one finger after the next. Start with finger 3 on E.

tunes.title: Lightly Row
tunes.right: g4 e e2 f4 d d2 c4 d e f g g g2 g4 e e2 f4 d d2 c4 e g g c1 d4 d d d d e f2 e4 e e e e f g2 g4 e e2 f4 d d2 c4 e g g c1
tunes.text: A boat song. It starts on G with finger 5 and skips down to E. Learn it four bars at a time.

tunes.title: Jingle Bells (chorus)
tunes.right: e4 e e2 e4 e e2 e4 g c4. d8 e1 f4 f f4. f8 f4 e e e8 e e4 d d e d2 g2 e4 e e2 e4 e e2 e4 g c4. d8 e1 f4 f f f f e e e8 e g4 g f d c1
tunes.text: Jingle bells, jingle bells: finger 3 plays lots of Es. Listen for the long notes and hold them.

tunes.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
tunes.right: c4 c g g a a g2 f4 f e e d d c2 g4 g f f e e d2 g4 g f f e e d2 c4 c g g a a g2 f4 f e e d d c2
tunes.text: Right hand on C. For 'little star' your pinky reaches up to A, then comes back to G.

tunes.title: Hot Cross Buns (both hands, held notes)
tunes.right: e4 d c2 e4 d c2 c8 c c c d d d d e4 d c2
tunes.text: The right hand plays the tune; the left hand holds long, low notes underneath: C with the pinky, and once G with the thumb.

tunes.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb (both hands, held notes)
tunes.right: e4 d c d e e e2 d4 d d2 e4 g g2 e4 d c d e e e e d d e d c1
tunes.left: C1 C1 G1 C1 C1 C1 G1 C1
tunes.text: Mary with a left hand underneath: a long C at the start of each bar, and G with the thumb when the tune sits on D.

tunes.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb (G position)
tunes.right: b4 a g a b b b2 a4 a a2 b4 d' d'2 b4 a g a b b b b a a b a g1
tunes.text: Mary moved up to G: thumb on G, and the same fingers as before. Read it from the music this time.

tunes.title: Hot Cross Buns (left hand, G position)
tunes.left: BB4 AA GG2 BB4 AA GG2 GG8 GG GG GG AA AA AA AA BB4 AA GG2
tunes.text: Left hand on G, pinky on the low G. Find B, A and G on the bass stave as you play.

tunes.title: Ode to Joy (G position)
tunes.right: b4 b c' d' d' c' b a g g a b b4. a8 a2 b4 b c' d' d' c' b a g g a b a4. g8 g2
tunes.text: Ode to Joy in G position: it starts on B with finger 3. Watch the notes step up and down the stave.

tunes.title: Lightly Row (G position)
tunes.right: d'4 b b2 c'4 a a2 g4 a b c' d' d' d'2 d'4 b b2 c'4 a a2 g4 b d' d' g1 a4 a a a a b c'2 b4 b b b b c' d'2 d'4 b b2 c'4 a a2 g4 b d' d' g1
tunes.text: Lightly Row in G position, starting on D with finger 5. Spot the skips: they jump from a line to a line, or a space to a space.

tunes.title: Au clair de la lune (both hands, held notes)
tunes.right: c4 c c d e2 d2 c4 e d d c1 c4 c c d e2 d2 c4 e d d c1
tunes.left: C1 C2 G2 C2 G2 C1 C1 C2 G2 C2 G2 C1
tunes.text: Read both staves: the tune on top, held C and G in the left hand below. The left hand changes on the middle of a bar.

tunes.title: Ode to Joy (both hands, held notes)
tunes.right: e4 e f g g f e d c c d e e4. d8 d2 e4 e f g g f e d c c d e d4. c8 c2
tunes.left: C1 G1 C1 G1 C1 G1 C1 G2 C2
tunes.text: Ode to Joy with the left hand taking turns between C (pinky) and G (thumb), one held note a bar.

tunes.title: Lightly Row (both hands, held notes)
tunes.right: g4 e e2 f4 d d2 c4 d e f g g g2 g4 e e2 f4 d d2 c4 e g g c1 d4 d d d d e f2 e4 e e e e f g2 g4 e e2 f4 d d2 c4 e g g c1
tunes.left: C1 G1 C1 C1 C1 G1 C1 C1 G1 G1 C1 C1 C1 G1 C1 C1
tunes.text: Lightly Row with held left-hand notes. Look ahead: which bars does the thumb play G?

tunes.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star (both hands, held notes)
tunes.right: c4 c g g a a g2 f4 f e e d d c2 g4 g f f e e d2 g4 g f f e e d2 c4 c g g a a g2 f4 f e e d d c2
tunes.left: C1 F2 C2 F2 C2 G2 C2 C2 F2 C2 G2 C2 F2 C2 G2 C1 F2 C2 F2 C2 G2 C2
tunes.text: Twinkle with a left hand that moves twice a bar: C, F and G. Your left hand stays on C; finger 2 plays F.
